snippet.title: Halo MCC: Halo CE Campaign Mod - Mercury Rising
snippet.description:
Hey there peeps and welcome back everyone to another Halo CE campaign mod showcase! In this video, we will be checking out a custom campaign mission based on a multiplayer map Mercury Falling. This is Mercury Rising, created by altis94!

Download link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3021510694

►Become a Channel Member: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCs_n7eqIvJhdzz4vWM2aiLQ/join
►Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/xXBarthXx
►Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/xxbarthxx
►Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/_xXBarthXx_

Investigate a mysterious distress signal and find out what happened.

About The Mod
Mercury Rising is a custom campaign mission based on a multiplayer map Mercury Falling. It's using a variety of cut and custom assets all of which have been edited to some extent to work properly. The map is fairly open and you can take different routes to reach your destination which will give you a different experience every time you play.

The entire mod has been made in roughly 5 weeks. There are some things that could have been done better but the whole idea was to make the mod as fast as altis94 could.

Co-op
The mod works on co-op. Each player has a slightly different character model and both players appear during cutscenes.

Equipment
There are 2 new grenade types:
Bubble Shield - Provides cover for 10 seconds
Health Regeneration - Restores player's health and shields over time

Credits
Skilit / TGCheeky, Wolf - Original Mercury Falling map
Digsite team - Cyborg, Drinol and Slug Man bipeds, Shadow and Spectre vehicles
VKMT - Gravity Rifle, Excavator, Sniper Rifle weapons
The Silent Cartographer: Evolved team - Forerunner textures
Galap - Fixed engineer animations
unevenelefant5 - marine and sentinel variants, artybug biped, chaingun and SMG weapons
Lone Warrior - Sentinel Crawler biped
Donut, ICEE - Griever weapon
Jahrain - Revolver weapon
Hispa, ConnorDawn, JERKAKAME, Burney, PrecutODST, bourrin, unevenelefant5 - testing
cheechas - Soundtrack
upscale.media - Texture upscaling
elevenlabs.io - AI voice acting
textures.com - Terrain textures

You can listen to the soundtrack here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a6GpukwEnsY

There are 3 hidden Moa statues which will activate a secret :)
